subject: general
question: The Indian Army inaugurated the ‘Arogyam health & wellness centre’ in Tawang under operation Sadbhavana. When was Operation Sadbhavana launched by the Indian Army?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**1998**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Army inaugurates ‘Arogyam health & wellness centre’ in Tawang under operation Sadbhavana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Operation Sadbhavana** launched in **1998** by the Indian Army.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to win the **hearts and minds** of people affected by **terrorism**, **insurgency**, and slow development.

 
 
• 
 
Primarily focused on **Jammu & Kashmir**, **Ladakh**, and parts of **Northeast India**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative addresses local aspirations through **education**, **health camps**, **women’s empowerment**, **employment generation**, and **infrastructure development**.

 
 
• 
 
**Arogyam Health and Wellness Centre** inaugurated at **DahJhong** in **Tawang district**.
